quality_boundary: This Phase 14 inventory verifies Kurume's new 2026-2035 comprehensive plan, policy-evaluation route, FY2026 budget, and FY2024 prior-plan settlement. It preserves plan-layer periods and prior/current boundaries and does not convert municipal indicators, budget allocation, or fiscal results into independent achievement, causal, or comparison judgments.
